developments.title: Google DeepMind releases EmbeddingGemma 2 open-weight multimodal embedder

claims.text: Google DeepMind released EmbeddingGemma 2 as an open multimodal embedding model that maps text, code, images, video, and audio into a shared 768-dimensional space.
claims.evidence: Google DeepMind has released EmbeddingGemma 2, an open model that embeds text, code, images, video and audio into one 768-dimensional space.
Built on the Gemma 4 architecture and released under a commercially permissive Apache 2.0 license, EmbeddingGemma 2 has 740 million parameters, making it optimal for on-device inference.
claims.text: The model has 740 million parameters, is built on the Gemma 4 architecture, and is licensed under the Apache 2.0 license.
Its weights are available for download on Hugging Face and Kaggle.
claims.evidence: Download the models: Find the model weights on Hugging Face and Kaggle, with Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform Model Garden availability coming soon.

claims.text: Aleph Alpha released Kolibri-1 on Hugging Face as an open-weight mixture-of-experts language model with an Apache 2.0 license.
claims.evidence: Aleph Alpha published Kolibri-1 on Hugging Face on October 3, an open-weight language model with 78.1 billion total parameters (3.46 billion active per token), an Apache 2.0 license and a context window reaching 1,048,576 tokens.

Kolibri-1 is a bilingual Mixture-of-Experts language model (German and English) from Aleph Alpha, with 78.1 billion total parameters, 3.46 billion active per token, 50 layers and an Apache 2.0 license.
claims.text: The model features 78.1 billion total parameters with 3.46 billion active per token and supports bilingual German and English workloads with a 1-million-token context window.
